citizen.name: Perrin Ashgrove
citizen.learned: Tended coastal signal lamps for eleven years until his station was decommissioned; came looking for the one lighthouse rumored to still get an answer from the sea.
citizen.lifestyle: Wakes before dawn to check lens and wick, spends afternoons repairing gear, walks the pier at dusk watching the horizon.
citizen.currently: Trying to work out whether the light Emmet saw two nights ago was a real ship's lamp or fog-trick, and hoping Ines will let him help keep the lighthouse.

relationships: newly arrived, eager to help tend the lamp
listened closely to Emmet's account of the answering light
compared notes on tides and signal lights

text: A stranger stepped off a fishing boat at first light, saying he'd seen the same light Emmet described, three nights running, and had rowed a long way to find out what it meant.
